description: Presidential Secretariat - Sri Lanka Ports Authority all Fuels Transport etc. to be an Essential Public Services
categorisation: This gazette content involves the declaration of essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory framework that establishes legal requirements for service provision during emergencies. The content focuses on creating legal obligations and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
